lane_impact: Cross-lane guard rail. It disproves the survey's licence sentence ('retires the android parity not established caveat for the combat HUD') by counterexample INSIDE the same class, and it establishes the working method for every future claim: shs3_payload/scripts/ is obfuscated but numeric literals and public member names survive, so any constant can be confirmed against the real web build by grepping for the literal. quote: android: `newframe = int(this.cooldown / this.cooldownmax * 12) + 1;` — web: `_loc1_ = Math.ceil(this.cooldown / this.cooldownmax * 12) + 1;`. §1t5184s0§ is confirmed as the web SkillSlotButton by four independent markers: stat 2501 ammo read at :109, Math.floor(getStat(2501)/4) Windmill rule at :113, three stance-gated early returns at :213/:217/:221, and --this.cooldown at :225 — the same structure as android :110/:114/:211-219.
text: The web build v0.717 and the Android build v0.682 diverge inside SkillSlotButton.update(): Android truncates the cooldown sweep with int(), the web rounds up with Math.ceil(), so the two builds show a different shade frame for essentially every intermediate cooldown value.
